name: Anonymous Babylonian Poets
credit: The Flood Tablet (Tablet XI of the Epic of Gilgamesh, British Museum K.3375), Nineveh, 7th century BC · An artifact, shown because no portrait exists for anonymous poets · Public domain (Wikimedia Commons)
bio: The Babylonian poets are unnamed scribes and singers who composed in Akkadian and wrote in cuneiform on clay tablets. Their works, among them the Epic of Gilgamish, survive in Old Babylonian, Hittite and Assyrian copies, the fullest being the seventh-century BC tablets from the royal library at Nineveh.
The Epic of Gilgamish is given here in R. Campbell Thompson's verse translation of 1928.
